meta.name: parallel-feature-development
meta.description: Coordinate parallel feature development with file ownership strategies, conflict avoidance rules, and integration patterns for multi-agent implementation. Use this skill when decomposing a large feature into independent work streams, when two or more agents need to implement different layers of the same system simultaneously, when establishing file ownership to prevent merge conflicts in a shared codebase, when designing interface contracts so parallel implementers can build against each other's APIs before they are ready, or when deciding whether to use vertical slices versus horizontal layers for a full-stack feature.

copy.tagline: 把大型功能拆成小块，多团队同时开发互不干扰
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队需要多人同时开发一个功能的不同部分
copy.tagline_en: Coordinate parallel development of large features without conflicts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team develops different parts of a feature concurrently

howto.what: 把一个较大功能拆成可并行的独立工作流,给每个实现者分配文件归属、设定防冲突规则、设计只读接口契约,并给出集成方式与分支策略。
howto.when: 当你需要把功能拆分给多个 agent 并行实现、划分文件归属以防合并冲突,或设计接口契约时触发。

say.text: 把这个登录功能拆成几个可并行的工作流,并分配文件归属
say.note: 会给出拆分方案与归属规则

say.text: 两个 agent 同时改同一系统的不同层,怎么避免合并冲突?
say.note: 会给出单归属和抽取接口的办法

say.text: 帮我为并行实现者写一份只读的接口契约文件
say.note: 会定义好契约供双方 import

howto.what_en: Claude decomposes a feature into parallel work streams, assigns one owner per file, designs read-only interface contracts, and picks integration and branch strategies.
howto.when_en: Use when splitting a feature across multiple agents working at once, when setting file ownership to avoid merge conflicts, or when designing interface contracts.

say_en.text: Split this login feature into parallel work streams and assign file owners
say_en.note: You get a split plan with ownership rules

say_en.text: Two agents edit different layers of one system, how do I avoid merge conflicts?
say_en.note: It gives single-owner and interface-extraction options

say_en.text: Write a read-only interface contract both implementers can import
say_en.note: It defines types and methods in a contract file
